concepts.name: 1500-1880s Introduction This Unit Studie
concepts.simple_definition: 141 Text Book Page UNIT SIX AFRICA AND THE OUTSIDE WORLD: 1500-1880s Introduction This unit studies the relationship between Africa and the outside world between the 16th and 19th centuries, which later on became the basis for the European conquest and coloni- zation of Africa
concepts.deep_explanation: Major themes discussed in the unit are pre-colonial African states, appear- ance of the Portuguese colonizers to coastal areas of Africa, the Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade, the legitimate commerce, and explorations of Africa that opened the way for the European scramble, and partition of African continent in the 1880s
